description: Search Australia's live wholesale plant market: which wholesale growers list a plant, in which pot sizes, and from what trade price (AUD, ex GST). Use it for "who grows X" or "what does X cost wholesale". Botanical or common names both work.

query.description: Plant name, botanical or common, e.g. 'Lomandra Tanika' or 'lilly pilly'.

size.description: Optional pot size, e.g. 140mm, 45L or Tube.

state.description: Optional state or province code to limit growers, e.g. QLD, NSW, FL.

name: search_plants
title: Search wholesale plants
